Record Class ParallelConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.llm.parallel.ParallelConfig
Record Components:
tpSize - tensor-parallel size (must divide attention / FFN widths).
ppSize - pipeline-parallel size (must be 1 until phase 2).
dpSize - data-parallel size (must be 1 in phase 1).
devices - CUDA device indices for local TP ranks (length == tpSize).
public record ParallelConfig(int tpSize, int ppSize, int dpSize, byte[] devices) extends Record
Process-mesh configuration for tensor / pipeline / data parallelism.

worldSize == tpSize * ppSize * dpSize. Phase 1 uses ppSize=1 and dpSize=1; pipeline axes are reserved for multi-node PP.
